comments: β numerical validation — Monte Carlo check of the analytical variance
formula for the octonion associator, Fano-triple case.
Setup (per docs/research/variance_of_associator.md § "Worked example:
single Fano generator"):
A(a, b, c) := ‖[a, b, c]‖²   where [a,b,c] = (a·b)·c − a·(b·c)
Unperturbed: [a,b,c] = 2·e_7, A = 4.
Perturb a_1 → 1 + δ, δ ~ N(0, σ²). The analytical first-order GUM
variance (from the β document, derivation):
Var(A) ≈ 64 σ²                                (TRUTH)
If the current compiler's stepwise scalar-product rule were applied
instead, it would give:
Var_compiler(A) ≈ 16 σ²                       (COMPILER, 4× low)
This test computes the sample variance of A over N = 100,000 Monte
Carlo samples and compares to the TRUTH formula. It does NOT test the
compiler's variance_of() — that requires the full Knowledge<f64>
chain which introduces unrelated complexities (see ζ buffer bug). The
compiler comparison is deferred to a separate test.
Pass criterion: |MC_var − 64σ²| / 64σ² < 0.05 (5% relative error).
If this passes, β's analytical formula is validated empirically. The
remaining claim — that the compiler produces 16σ² — is then a
separate reading-confirmation task.

instruction: Write a Sounio run-pass example named `epistemic_var_accumulator_slots`. Regression pin for #1535: a mutable local must carry its uncertainty across reassignment, including when it was initialised from an EXPRESSION and when the reassignment happens inside a loop. It should compile and run successfully. Expected stdout: VAR_ACCUM_OK
description: Regression pin for #1535: a mutable local must carry its uncertainty across reassignment, including when it was initialised from an EXPRESSION and when the reassignment happens inside a loop.
comments: Regression pin for #1535: a mutable local must carry its uncertainty across
reassignment, including when it was initialised from an EXPRESSION and when the
reassignment happens inside a loop.
Two defects sat here, and the second hid behind the first:
1. Assignment REBOUND the local's variance/sens to the RHS's fresh vregs
instead of copying into fixed slots. A rebind is a compile-time map update
and a loop body's IR is emitted once, so every iteration recomputed from
the pre-loop uncertainty and only one iteration's contribution survived.
2. The fix for (1) allocated those slots BEFORE the branches that bind a
declaration's variance from its RHS, so those branches overwrote them.
Only a literal-initialised local escaped, because a literal leaves those
branches nothing to bind.
Truth values below are first-order GUM propagation, computed independently
rather than read off either engine. var(cl) = 1.24^2 = 1.5376.
TEST 1 deliberately uses NO loop. The defect never needed one — a loop only
turned a wrong answer into a catastrophic one. Four loop-based repros failed to
separate the two causes; three straight-line assignments did it immediately.
If this pin ever regresses, TEST 1 is the one that localises it.

comments: #1586/#1570: the native_v2 label tier (NC_V2_LABEL_* in self-hosted/native/
frame.sio) was [i64; 256] with BOTH bounds silent -- no else, no sentinel.
An `if` lowers to 2 labels + 2 jump patches, so the cap bit at ~128 `if`s in
ONE function. Past that, nc_add_label_patch dropped the patch and the jz/jmp
rel32 operand stayed at its placeholder 0, so the branch fell through instead
of jumping. The program still exited 0. Measured on a flat chain of N
comparisons, the number of WRONG results was exactly N - 128.
TWO THINGS ABOUT THE SHAPE OF THIS TEST ARE THE TEST.
1. It must all be in ONE function. nc_v2_reset_label_state runs at the top of
every function, so splitting these across helpers gives each a fresh
counter and the bug disappears -- which is exactly why "move it into a
helper function" was the documented workaround on #1570, #1577 and #1586,
and why nothing in the suite caught this.
2. They must be STRAIGHT-LINE `if`s, not a loop. A loop body allocates its
labels once at lowering time no matter how many times it runs, so a
hundred-iteration loop contributes about six labels and proves nothing.
150 independent `if`s => 300 labels, past the old 256 cap and inside the
current one. `acc` is threaded through so none of them can be folded away.
